scene: The radio broadcasts three departure gates across the yard.
picture: A flat side-view pixel yard. Far left, a glass elevator stands with glowing open doors. Left, the girl with a black braid in her purple wheelchair tunes the rusted radio. Right, a striped steam train idles on tracks. Up high, a moored yellow airship bobs beside a metal ladder at the far right.
